method: All 30 pages were previously rendered and manually viewed in full. Independently rendered every revised page at the same 1.25 scale and compared all RGB pixels against the accepted full-page renders. All 14 ASP24 and 16 NG Group pages are pixel-identical. Unchanged pages were not redundantly reread.
observations: All 14 ASP24 and 16 NG Group pages have legible text, unbroken tables/captions, coherent hierarchy and no overlap, clipping or short spill pages.
Accepted vector covers preserve all pixels at 72 dpi and selectable text; logical H1/P order matches the top-to-bottom layout.
ASP24 p. 6 keeps five DC outputs separate from USB; E01 distinguishes device and battery; quantities, units and prices remain unchanged.
NG Group p. 5 retains the confirmed publication discrepancy and unknown delivery passport; p. 6 conditional energy/time values and historical E02 attribution remain intact.
R34 remains open; no service process facts were invented.
limitations: Machine PDF/UA-1 profile PASS does not substitute for assistive-technology reading.
This acceptance is bound to PDF SHA-256, not an uncommitted Git SHA or published HTTPS.
